<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Fiche terrain – Chouette chevêche</title>

<style>
body {
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  background:#cfe8db;
  margin:0;
  padding:15px;
}
.container {
  max-width:900px;
  margin:auto;
  background:#e9f6f0;
  padding:20px;
  border-radius:12px;
}
.logos {
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:center;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}
.logos img { height:80px; }
h1 { text-align:center; }
h2 {
  background:#b7ddcc;
  padding:10px;
  border-left:6px solid #2c7c5c;
  margin-top:30px;
}
.field-group {
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:20px;
}
.field {
  flex:1;
  min-width:200px;
}
label { font-weight:bold; }
input, textarea {
  width:100%;
  padding:10px;
  margin-top:6px;
}
input[readonly] {
  background:#dfeee7;
}
textarea { min-height:120px; }
.checkbox-group label { margin-right:25px; }
table {
  width:100%;
  border-collapse:collapse;
  margin-top:10px;
}
th, td {
  border:1px solid #666;
  padding:12px;
}
th { background:#dff1e8; }
.btn {
  margin-top:12px;
  padding:10px 16px;
  background:#2c7c5c;
  color:white;
  border:none;
  border-radius:6px;
  font-weight:bold;
}
.btn-remove { background:#b33a3a; }
.btn-group {
  display:flex;
  gap:10px;
  margin-top:10px;
}
.signature-box {
  border:1px solid #555;
  height:160px;
  background:white;
  margin-top:10px;
}
.notice {
  font-size:0.9em;
  margin-top:10px;
}
</style>
</head>

<body>
<div class="container">

<div class="logos">
  <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Commune d’Assérac">
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="PNR de Brière">
</div>

<h1>FICHE TERRAIN – Chouette chevêche<br><small><em>Athene noctua</em></small></h1>

<h2>1. Informations générales</h2>
<div class="field-group">
  <div class="field"><label>Observateur</label><input value="Titouan Crespin" readonly></div>
  <div class="field"><label>Date</label><input type="date"></div>
  <div class="field"><label>Commune</label><input value="Assérac" readonly></div>
  <div class="field"><label>Heure de début</label><input type="time"></div>
  <div class="field"><label>Heure de fin</label><input type="time"></div>
</div>

<h2>2. Conditions météorologiques</h2>
<div class="checkbox-group">
  <label><input type="checkbox"> Ensoleillé</label>
  <label><input type="checkbox"> Couvert</label>
  <label><input type="checkbox"> Pluie</label>
  <label><input type="checkbox"> Brouillard</label>
</div>

<h2>3. Généralités</h2>
<label>Présence de l’espèce sur la maille :</label>
<label><input type="radio" name="presence"> Oui</label>
<label><input type="radio" name="presence"> Non</label>

<table id="genTable">
<thead><tr><th>Maille</th><th>Nombre d’individus</th></tr></thead>
<tbody></tbody>
</table>
<div class="btn-group">
  <button class="btn" onclick="addRow('genTable')">➕ Ajouter une ligne</button>
  <button class="btn btn-remove" onclick="removeRow('genTable')">➖ Supprimer une ligne</button>
</div>

<h2>4. Période de reproduction</h2>
<p><strong>Nombre total de couples</strong></p>
<table id="coupleTable">
<thead><tr><th>Maille</th><th>Nombre de couples</th></tr></thead>
<tbody></tbody>
</table>
<div class="btn-group">
  <button class="btn" onclick="addRow('coupleTable')">➕ Ajouter une ligne</button>
  <button class="btn btn-remove" onclick="removeRow('coupleTable')">➖ Supprimer une ligne</button>
</div>

<p><strong>Nombre de naissances par couple</strong></p>
<table id="birthTable">
<thead><tr><th>Maille</th><th>Nombre d’individus</th></tr></thead>
<tbody></tbody>
</table>
<div class="btn-group">
  <button class="btn" onclick="addRow('birthTable')">➕ Ajouter une ligne</button>
  <button class="btn btn-remove" onclick="removeRow('birthTable')">➖ Supprimer une ligne</button>
</div>

<h2>5. Période après reproduction</h2>
<table id="juvTable">
<thead><tr><th>Maille</th><th>Nombre de juvéniles</th></tr></thead>
<tbody></tbody>
</table>
<div class="btn-group">
  <button class="btn" onclick="addRow('juvTable')">➕ Ajouter une ligne</button>
  <button class="btn btn-remove" onclick="removeRow('juvTable')">➖ Supprimer une ligne</button>
</div>

<h2>6. Commentaires</h2>
<textarea></textarea>

<h2>7. Signature de l’observateur</h2>
<div class="field-group">
  <div class="field"><label>Fait à</label><input value="Assérac" readonly></div>
  <div class="field"><label>Le</label><input type="date"></div>
</div>
<canvas id="signature" class="signature-box"></canvas>

<button class="btn" onclick="sendToExcel()">📤 Envoyer les données vers Excel</button>
<p class="notice">Envoi sécurisé via Power Automate.</p>

</div>

<script>
function addRow(id) {
  let tbody = document.getElementById(id).querySelector("tbody");
  let tr = document.createElement("tr");
  tr.innerHTML = "<td contenteditable='true'></td><td contenteditable='true'></td>";
  tbody.appendChild(tr);
}

function removeRow(id) {
  let tbody = document.getElementById(id).querySelector("tbody");
  if (tbody.lastChild) tbody.removeChild(tbody.lastChild);
}

// Signature
let canvas = document.getElementById("signature");
let ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let drawing = false;
canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => drawing = true);
canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", () => { drawing = false; ctx.beginPath(); });
canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", draw);

function draw(e) {
  if (!drawing) return;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.lineTo(e.offsetX, e.offsetY);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(e.offsetX, e.offsetY);
}

// Power Automate
function sendToExcel() {
  fetch("https://default8d76891a1175498c91e589aaa568f7.c4.environment.api.powerplatform.com:443/powerautomate/automations/direct/workflows/4f9e041765104023b669424e165137ef/triggers/manual/paths/invoke?api-version=1", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      observateur: "Titouan Crespin",
      commune: "Assérac"
    })
  })
  .then(() => alert("Données envoyées vers Excel ✅"))
  .catch(() => alert("Erreur lors de l’envoi ❌"));
}
</script>

</body>
</html>
